scope: frozen B1 development error attribution; reference used only for diagnosis

reason_definitions.tp: scorable reference target area selected as this target
reason_definitions.fn_structure_exclusion: target centroid box hit removed by the structure prior (takes precedence over overlap)
reason_definitions.fn_target_box_overlap: target centroid box hit and another box hit, with no structure exclusion; B1 is -2
reason_definitions.fn_outside_target_box_other_object: centroid outside the target box plus margin and uniquely assigned to another object
reason_definitions.fn_outside_target_box_other_overlap: centroid outside the target box plus margin and unresolved in multiple other boxes
reason_definitions.fn_outside_target_box_environment: centroid outside the target box plus margin and assigned environment; raw structure flag is also retained
reason_definitions.fp_other_object: uniquely accepted target centroid prior covers sampled area matched to another reference object
reason_definitions.fp_environment: uniquely accepted target centroid prior covers sampled area matched to reference environment
reason_definitions.tn: scorable non-target reference area not selected as this target
reason_definitions.unscorable_predicted_target: unscorable sampled area on faces selected as this target
reason_definitions.unscorable_other: unscorable sampled area on faces not selected as this target

parameters.trace_rule: unchanged evaluator; temporary batch-local face IDs as grouping keys

limitations: nearest reference matching has no normal or visibility filter
unreconstructed physical surfaces are not partition errors
finite barycentric area estimates; no real-scene or held-out generalization
prior decision traces explain selection mechanics, not colour or ultimate physical causality
